recipes.name: Green Pea, Edamame & Mint Dip
instructions: Cook the peas and edamame in a saucepan of boiling water for 3 minutes, or according to package instructions, then drain.
Place all the ingredients in a food processor and blend until creamy.
Taste test and adjust to your liking. Add more tahini for a creamier consistency. Add more lemon for more zest.

page_recipe_notes: Storage Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 5 days.
